य: य The twenty-six consonant of the Nāgari alphabet, or semi-vowel Y; in Bengal, it is usually pronounced J.

य mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who goes, a goer, a mover. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. Union, Joining. 	 3. Fame, celebrity. 	 4. Barley. 	 5. Light, lustre. 6. Abandoning. 	 7. YAMA. 	 f. (-या) 	 1. Pudendum muliebre. 	 2. Going, proceeding. 	 3. A car, a carriage. 	 4. Prohibiting, restraining, check-ing. 	 5. Religious meditation. 	 6. Getting, obtaining.  E. यज् to wor-ship, or यम् to check, &c., aff. ड; or या-ड ।
य(ज)मदग्रि m. (-ग्निः) 	 1. The saint JAMADAGNI, the father of the first RĀMA.
यक: यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Which, (of many.)  E. यद् which, and अकच् aff.
यकृत्: यकृत् m. (-कृत्) The liver.  E. य union, (of the parts of the body,) कृ to make, aff. क्विप् and तुक् augment. यकन् is optionally substituted for this word in some of the declensions.
यकृदात्मिका: यकृदात्मिका f. (-का) A cock-roach.  E. यकृत् the liver, आत्मन् self, कन् aff., fem. form; like it in colour.
यकृद्वैरी: यकृद्वैरी f. (-री) A plant, a sort of tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.)  E. यकृत् liver, वैर inimical to.
यक्ष्: यक्ष् r. 10th cl (यक्षयते) To worship, to honour or adore.
यक्ष: यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A demi-god, attendant especially on KUVERA, and em-ployed in the care of his gardens and treasures. 	 2. A name of KUVERA. 	 3. The residence of INDRA. 	 f. (-क्षी) The wife of KUVERA.  E. यक्ष् to worship, aff. घञ्.
यक्षकर्दम: यक्षकर्द्दम m. (-मः) Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.
यक्षकर्द्दम: यक्षकर्द्दम m. (-मः) Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.
यक्षग्रह: यक्षग्रह m. (-हः) The being possessed by an evil spirit.
यक्षधूप: यक्षधूप m. (-पः) 	 1. Resin in general. 	 2. Turpentine, the resinous exuda-tion of the pine.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, धूप perfume or incense, अण् aff. “सर्ज्जरसे” धुना इति माषा ।
यक्षरस: यक्षरस m. (-सः) Spirituous or vinous liquor.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, रस taste, fondness.
यक्षराज्: यक्षराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the deity of wealth, and lord of the demi-gods called Yakshas. 	 2. A palæstrum, a place prepared for wrest-ling or boxing.  E. यक्ष a Yaksha, and राज who rules or shines.
यक्षराज: यक्षराज m. (-जः) KUVERA: see the last.
यक्षराट्पुरी: यक्षराट्पुरी f. (-री) Alakā, the capital of KUVERA, supposed to be seated on mount Kailāsa.  E. यक्षराज, पुरी city.
यक्षरात्रि: यक्षरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The night of the day of full moon in the month of Kārtika: see दीपाली.  E. यक्ष the demi-god, रात्रि night; these spirits being supposed to be then abroad.
यक्षवित्त: यक्षवित्त Adj. One who stores up wealth but never uses it.
यक्षामलक: यक्षामलक m. (-कः) A tree, described as a sort of date.  E. यक्ष a Yaksha, आमलक myrobalan. “पिण्डीखेजुर ।”
यक्षावास: यक्षावास m. (-सः) The Indian fig-tree, (Ficus Indica.)  E. यक्ष a demi-god, आवास abode. “वटवृक्षे ।”
यक्षिणी: यक्षिणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The wife of KUVERA. 	 2. The wife of a Yaksha. 	 3. A sort of female fiend, attached to the service of DURGĀ, and frequently maintaining, like a sylph or fairy, an intercourse with mortals.  E. यक्षिन् a name of KUVERA, and ङीष् aff.
यक्षेन्द्र: यक्षेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KUVERA.  E. यक्ष, and इन्द्र lord.
यक्षेश: यक्षेश m. (-शः) KUVERA.  E. यक्ष, and ईश lord; also यक्षेश्वर and the like.
यक्षोडुम्बुरक: यक्षोडुम्बुरक n. (-कं) The fruit of the Ficus religiosa.
यक्ष्मघ्नी: यक्ष्मघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) The raisin, dried-grape.  E. यक्ष्म consumption, घ्न destroyer.
यक्ष्मन्: यक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption.  E. यक्ष् to worship, and मनिन् Unādi aff.; also with मन् aff., यक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः).
यक्ष्मिन्: यक्ष्मिन् f. (-क्ष्मिणी) One who suffers from consumption.
यक्ष्यमाण: यक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Proposing or wishing to worship.  E. यक्ष् to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
यङ्न्त: यङ्न्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative deponent verb, (in gram.)  E. यङ्, अन्त termination.
यङ्लुगन्त: यङ्लुगन्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative active verb.  E. यङ्, लुक् dropped, and अन्त termination.
यज्: यज् r. 1st. cl. (यजति-ते) 	 1. To worship a deity. 	 2. To associate with. 	 3. To present or endow.
यजत्: यजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Sacrificing, worshipping. E.  E. यज् to wor-ship, शतृ aff.
यजत: यजत m. (-तः) The officiating priest at a sacrifice.  E. यज् to worship, अतच् aff.
यजति: यजति m. (-तिः) A term for those sacrifices to which the verb यजति is applied, as distinguished from those rites to which the verb जुहोति applies. Sarvajnya-Nārāyana renders जुहोति by उपविष्टहोम and यजति by तिष्ठद्धोम्  E. यज-अतिच ।
यजत्र: यजत्र m. (-त्रः) A Brāhamana who has maintained his consecrated fire. E. यज् to sacrifice, अत्रन् Unādi aff.
यजन: यजन n. (-नं) Offering sacrifices, performing worship.  E. यज् to worship, ल्युट् aff.
यजन्त: यजन्त m. (-न्तः) A sacrificer, a worshipper.  E. यज् to sacrifice, aff. झच्.
यजमान: यजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Worshipping. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. An employer of priests at sacrifice, the person who institutes its performance, and pays the expence of it. 	 2. A patron, a host.  E. यज् to worship, शानच् aff. of the present participle, with मक् augment.
यजाक: यजाक m. (-कः) A donor, a benefactor, a liberal giver of presents, &c. E. यज् to present, Unādi aff. आकन् ।
यजि: यजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, one who institutes or performs a sacrifice. E. यज् to sacrifice, aff. इन् ।
यजुर्वेद: यजुर्वेद n. (-दं) The Yajur-Veda: see the next.  E. यजुस्, वेद a Veda.
यजुस्: यजुस् n. (-जुः) The Yajur or Yajush, one of the four Vedas; it is di-vided into two principal portions, the white and black, or Vāja-saneyi and Taittirīya, the former of which is attributed to the saint YĀJNAWALKYA, to whom it was revealed by the sun, in the form of a horse; and the latter to TAITTIRI, to whom it was communicated by YĀSKA, the first pupil of its original author, the sage VAIŚAMPĀYANA: according to the Purāṇas the Taittirīya portion was named from Tittiri a partridge; the disciples of VAIŚAMPĀYANA being changed into those birds, to pick up the texts of the Veda as they were disgorged in a tangible shape by YĀJNAWALKYA, at the command of VAIŚAM-PĀYANA: both portions of this Veda are very full on the sub-ject of religious rites, and the prayers peculiar to it, are chiefly in measured and poetical prose.  E. यज् to worship, Unādi aff. उसि ।
यज्ञ: यज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sacrifice, a ceremony in which oblations are presented. E. यज् to worship, aff. नङ् ।
यज्ञकर्मन्: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act of ceremony.  E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
यज्ञकर्म्मन्: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act of ceremony.  E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
यज्ञकल्प: यज्ञकल्प Adj. Of the nature of a sacrifice.
यज्ञकीलक: यज्ञकीलक m. (-कः) The post to which the victim is fastened at a sacri-fice.
यज्ञकुण्ड: यज्ञकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hole in the ground built for receiving the sacrificial fire.
यज्ञकृत्: यज्ञकृत् m. (-कृत्) A sacrificer, a worshipper, or priest conducting a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, कृत् who makes.
यज्ञक्रतु: यज्ञक्रतु m. (-तुः) 	 1. A complete rite. 	 2. VISHṆU.
यज्ञद्रुह्: यज्ञद्रुह् m. (-ध्रुक्) A Rākshasa, an imp.  E. यज्ञ, द्रुह् to wrong, क्विप् aff.
यज्ञपशु: यज्ञपशु m. (-शुः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. Any animal offered in sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and पशु an animal.
यज्ञपात्र: यज्ञपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. यज्ञ, and पात्र a vessel.
यज्ञपुरुष: यज्ञपुरुष m. (-षः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, पुरुष man or male.
यज्ञभाजन: यज्ञभाजन n. (-नं) A sacrificial vessel.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and भाजन vessel.
यज्ञभूमि: यज्ञभूमि f. (-मिः) Place prepared for a sacrifice, or where it is offered. E. यज्ञ, and भूमि land.
यज्ञवराह: यज्ञवराह m. (-हः) VISHṆU in his boar-incarnation.  E. यज्ञ, and वराह the boar.
यज्ञवल्लि: यज्ञवल्लि f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली) The Soma plant; also यज्ञश्रेष्ठा ।
यज्ञवाट: यज्ञवाट m. (-टः) A place prepared and enclosed for a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, वाट inclosure.
यज्ञवेदि: यज्ञवेदि f. (-दिः or दी) A sacrificial altar.
यज्ञशरण: यज्ञशरण n. (-णं) A building or a temporary structure under which a sacrifice is performed.
यज्ञशिष्ट: यज्ञशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What is left from a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, शिष्ट remainder.
यज्ञशेष: यज्ञशेष m. (-षः) The relics of a sacrifice or oblation.  E. यज्ञ, शेष remainder.
यज्ञसदस्: यज्ञसदस् n. (-दः) An assembly of people at a sacrifice.
यज्ञसार: यज्ञसार m. (-रः) The glomerous fig-tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, सार essence. “यज्ञोडुम्बर वृक्षे ।”
यज्ञसिद्धि: यज्ञसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 	 1. Performance of sacrifice. 	 2. Obtaining the objects of a sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
यज्ञसूत्र: यज्ञसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The characteristic thread, worn by the three principal classes of Hindus.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सूत्र thread.
यज्ञस्थान: यज्ञस्थान n. (-नं) A place of sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ and स्थान place.
यज्ञाङ्ग: यज्ञाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The glomerous fig, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 	 2. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 	 3. A part of any sacrificial cere-mony.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, अङ्ग a member.
यज्ञान्त: यज्ञान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice.  E. यज्ञ the principal, अन्त end, finish.
यज्ञारि: यज्ञारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. A demon, a goblin.  E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, अरि enemy.
यज्ञिक: यज्ञिक m. (-कः) The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. यज्ञ, ठन् aff.
यज्ञिय: यज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Proper for or suitable to a sacrifice. 	 2. Pious. 3. Sacred. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. The third Yuga or Dwāpara age. 	 2. A god, a deity.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and घ aff.
यज्ञियदेश: यज्ञियदेश f. (-शः) The country of Hindus; those districts in which the ritual and institutes of the Hindu system are enforced; properly the country in which the black deer or antelope is native. E. यज्ञिय sacrificial, and देश a country.
यज्ञियशाला: यज्ञियशाला f. (-ला) A temple, a shrine, a place of sacrifice.  E. यज्ञिय to be sacrificed, (where,) शाला hall.
यज्ञोडुम्बर: यज्ञोडुम्बर m. (-रः) The glomerous fig-tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, उडुम्बर the same.
यज्ञोपकरण: यज्ञोपकरण n. (-णं) Any utensil or implement necessary for a sacrifice.
यज्ञोपवीत: यज्ञोपवीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial cord, originally worn by the three principal casts of Hindus: at present from the loss of the pure Kshetriya and Vaiśya casts in Bengal, confined to the Brāh-minical order.  E. यज्ञ sacrifice, उपवीत thread.
यज्ञोपवीतिन्: यज्ञोपवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brāhmana, &c. invested with the sacred thread. E. यज्ञोपवीत, इनि aff.
यज्यु: यज्यु m. (-ज्युः) A Brāhmana, conversant with the Yajur-Veda.  E. यज् to worship, Unādi aff. युच् ।
यज्वन्: यज्वन् m. (-ज्वा) 	 1. A sacrificer in due form, or agreeably to the ritual of the Vedas. 	 2. VISHṆU. 	 f. (-ज्वरी) Sacrificing, worshipping. E. यज् to worship, वनिप् aff.
यज्वनापति: यज्वनापति m. (-तिः) The moon.  E. यज्वन् a sacrificer in the sixth case plural, पति master.
यत्: यत् (ई) यती r. 1st cl. (यतते) To resolve or determine in consequence of a wish or desire, to apply or endeavour strenuously, to energize, to persevere. r. 10 cl. (यातयति-ते) 	 1. To distress or afflict. 	 2. To beat. 	 3. To order. 	 4. To collect, to assemble. 	 5. To work, to make or manufacture. 	 6. To prevent, to remove. 	 7. To return, to give back, to requite. 	 8. To barter or exchange. 	 9. To purify. 	 10. To encourage. With निर or वि prefixed, To chastise, to punish, to inflict pain. With निस् or प्रति, 1. To restore. 	 2. To requite.
यत् Ind. Because as, since, wherefore, correlative of तत् thence, there-fore, &c.  E. यत् to check, to restrain, क्विप् and तुक् affs.
यत: यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Governed, controlled. 	 2. Limited, restrained. 	 n. (-तं) The stirring of an elephant by means of the rider's feet. E. यम् to check, क्त aff.
यतचित्त: यतचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Resigned, subdued, one of well-governed thoughts or feelings.  E. यत and चित्त the mind.
यतचित्तात्मन्: यतचित्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Having power over the soul and spirit, of subdued mind.  E. यतचित्त, आत्मन् self.
यतत्: यतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Striving, making effort.  E. यत् to make effort, शतृ aff.
यतन: यतन n. (-नं) Making effort or exertion.  E. यत् to make effort, ल्युट् aff.
यतनीय: यतनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be exerted, or persevered, to be made as an effort.  E. यत् to make effort, अनीयर् aff.
यतम: यतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.)  E. यद् which, डतमच् aff.
यतमान: यतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Making effort, striving, struggling, persevering. E. यत् to strive, शानच् aff.
यतमैथुन: यतमैथुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Disinclined to sexual intercourse, abstaining from it.  E. यत, and मैथुन coition.
यतर: यतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रत्) Which, (of two), whether.  E. यद् which, डतरच् aff.
यतव्रत: यतव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Firm to an engagement or vow.  E. यत, व्रत a vow.
यतस्: यतस् Ind. Because, as, since, whence: see यत्  E. यद् which, what, and तसिल् substituted for the termination of the 5th case.
यतस्ततस्: यतस्ततस् Ind. 	 1. From any place whatsoever. 	 2. From any person.
यतात्मत्: यतात्मत् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued or well-governed spirit.  E. यत, आत्मन् self.
यतात्मवत्: यतात्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Self-subdued, having the mind and all its powers in subjection.  E. यतात्म, and मतुप् aff.
यताहार: यताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious.  E. यत, and आहार food.
यति: यति Pron. How many, as many, (declined only in the plural, nomi-native and accusative यति).

यति m. (-तिः) 	 1. A sage, whose passions are completely under subjec-tion. 	 2. A religious mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect. 	 3. Stopping, ceasing, rest, term. 	 4. Restraining, controlling, cheek-ing. 	 f. (-तिः) 	 1. A pause in poetry or metre, a stop, a rest. 	 2. Uni-on, joining. 	 3. Restraint, check. 	 4. Guidance.  E. यत् endeavour, &c., aff. इन्; or यम् to restrain, aff. क्तिन् ।
यतित: यतित f. (-ता) Adj. Attempted, striven after.
यतिन्: यतिन् m. (-ती) A sage with subdued passions. 	 f. (-नी) A widow.  E. यत restraining, from यम् with क्त aff. and इनि added.
यतिपात्र: यतिपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for collecting alms, made of wood, or a hol-low bamboo, an earthen bowl, or a gourd.  E. यति and पात्र a vessel.
यतिमैथुन: यतिमैथुन n. (-नं) The copulation or cohabitation of holy personages. E. यति as above, and सैथुन coition.
यतु: यतु(तू)का f. (-का) A plant, Chakāwat commonly. “वेतोशाक ।”
यतीन्द्रय: यतीन्द्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Chaste, pure, of subdued passions.  E. यत, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
यतेन्द्रिय: यतेन्द्रिय Adj. 	 m. (-यः) Of subdued passions, pious, pure.
यतोयतस्: यतोयतस् Ind. 	 1. From whatever place. 	 2. Wherever.
यत्कर: यत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Doing what.  E. यत् and कृ to do, अच् aff.
यत्त: यत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Striven, resolved, exerted.  E. यत् to resolve, क्त aff.
यत्न: यत्न m. (-त्नः) Effort, exertion, perseverance, energy.  E. यत् to endea-vour strenuously or continuously, aff. नङ् ।
यत्न Ind. 	 1. Where, in what place. 	 2. When. 	 3. Because, since, as that.  E. यद् what, and त्रल् aff.

यथोचित: यथोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Right, proper. Adv. 	 n. or ind. (-तं) Properly, suitably.  E. यथा, and उचित proper.

Plu. (-वाः) I. The Yādavas, the people of YADU. 	 2. Descendants of king YADU: more usually however यादवाः ।
यदुनाथ: यदुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. यदु the son of YAYĀTI, here put for his race, नाथ lord, chief.
यदृच्छा: यदृच्छा f. (-च्छा) 	 1. Wilfulness, independence, following one's own fan-cies. 	 2. (In grammar,) A noun which is neither a generic nor speci-fic term, or noun of agency; one either not derived from au-thority, or not possessing meaning.  E. यत् what, which, ऋच्छ् to go, affs. अ and टाप् ।
यदृच्छाभिज्ञ: यदृच्छाभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A voluntary or self-offered witness.  E. यदृच्छा, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
यद्यपि: यद्यपि Adv. Although.  E. यदि, and अपि certainly.
यद्वत्: यद्वत् Ind. As, in what manner, correlative to तद्वत्.  E. यद्, and वति aff.
यन्तृ: यन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) A check, a restraint, any person or thing that restrains, &c. 	 m. (-न्ता) 	 1. A charioteer. 	 2. An elephant-driver. E. यम् to restrain, aff. तृच् ।
यन्त्र्: यन्त्र् r. 1st and 10 cls. (यन्त्रति-ते यन्त्रयति-ते) To restrain: see यत्रि ।
यन्त्र: यन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 	 1. A machine in general, any implement or apparatus. 	 2. A diagram of a mystical nature, or astrological character. 	 3. A sort of vessel. 	 4. Restraining, checking, controlling. 	 5. A fetter, a cord. 	 6. A lock, a bolt.  E. यम् to check, Unādi aff. त्र; or यत्रि-अच् ।
यन्त्रक: यन्त्रक m. (-कः) One acquainted with machinery. 	 f. (-का) A wife's younger sister. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. A turner's lathe. 	 2. A bandage, (in medicine.)  E. यन्त्र a machine or restraining, &c., कन् added.
यन्त्रगृह: यन्त्रगृह n. (-हं) 	 1. An oil-mill. 	 2. A manufactory.  E. यन्त्र machine, the apparatus used for grinding substances yielding oil, गृह a house.
यन्त्रगोल: यन्त्रगोल m. (-लः) Common-pea.  E. यन्त्र a machine, and गोल round. “मटर ।”
यन्त्रण: यन्त्रण n. (-णं) 	 1. Pain, anguish, affliction. 	 2. Binding, confining. 	 3. Checking, controlling, especially the passions. 	 4. Guarding, pro-tecting.  E. यत्रि to restrain, &c., aff. ल्युट् ।
यन्त्रणी: यन्त्रणी f. (-णी) A wife's younger sister; also यन्त्रिणी ।
यन्त्रपेषणी: यन्त्रपेषणी f. (-णी) A handmill.  E. यन्त्र a machine, पेषणी a stone for grinding on.
यन्त्रित: यन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bound, tied, chained, fettered. 	 2. Checked, restrained.  E. यन्त्र restraining, and इतच् aff.
यन्त्रितकथ: यन्त्रितकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Restrained in speech, constrained to be silent. E. यन्त्रित, कथा speech.
यन्त्रिन्: यन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) 	 1. A horse furnished with harness or trappings. 	 2. A tormenter. 	 3. One having an amulet.
यम्: यम् (औ) यमौ r. 1st cl (यमति) To copulate.

यम् r. 1st cl. (औ, उ) औयमु (यच्छ्वति) To stop, to cease, to refrain. With नि prefixed, 1. To remove, to dispel. 	 2. To observe as a vow or religious rite. 	 3. To regulate, to restrain. With उत्, 1. To rise, to mount on. 	 2. To make effort or exertion. 	 3. To lift up, to raise. With वि and आङ्, To exercise. With सम् and नि, To restrain. To go to, to proceed to, With सम्, (संयच्छते) To heap together any thing that is one's own. (संयच्छति) To associate with. With उप, (उपयच्छते) 1. To marry. 	 2. To agree or accede to. 	 3. To master by learning. r. 10th cl. (यमयति-ते यामयति) 	 1. To feed, to give food to. 	 2. To restrain.
यम: यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Twin, fellow, one of the pair or brace. 	 m. (-मः) 	 1. Restraining, controlling. 	 2. Forbearance, refraining. 	 3. Cessa-tion, stop, conclusion, finish. 	 4. Religious restraint or obli-gation, considered the first of the eight steps of Yoga. 	 5. Penance, purification, the performance of those acts which re-move impurity of any kind. 	 6. Any of the five acts or virtues, which constitute pure characters, as refraining from violence or injury, patience, sincerity, obedience to a spiritual teacher, and the observance of all purificatory ceremonies. 	 7. A festival. 	 8. A crow. 	 9. A name of the planet SATURN. 	 10. YAMA, the deity of Naraka or hell, where his capital is placed, in which he sits in judgment on the dead, and distributes rewards and punishments, sending the good to Swarga, and the wicked to the division of Naraka or Tartarus appropriated to their crimes: he corresponds with the Grecian god PLUTO, and the judge of hell MINOS, and in Hindu mythology often identified with Death and Time: he is the son of SŪRYA, or the sun, and brother of the personified YA-MUNĀ or Jamunā river. 	 n. (-म) A brace, a couple, a pair. 	 f. (-मी) The Yamunā river.  E. यम् to restrain, &c., aff. अच्, घञ् or अप् ।

यमकिङ्कर: यमकिङ्कर m. (-रः) A messenger of death.
यमकीट: यमकीट m. (-टः) An earth worm.  E. यम YAMA, and कीट a worm.

यमभगिनी: यमभगिनी f. (-नी) The YAMUNĀ river.  E. यम YAMA, भगिनी sister.
यमयातना: यमयातना f. (-ना) 	 1. The torture inflicted after death by YAMA. 	 2. An extreme torture, (figuratively.)
यमरय: यमरय m. (-थः) A buffalo.  E. यम YAMA, and रय a car.
यमराज्: यमराज् m. (-राट्) YAMA, the Indian PLUTO.  E. यम YAMA, and राज् a ruler; also with a final vowel यमराज m. (-जः)
यमल: यमल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. A sort of dress, a bodice and petticoat. 	 2. A pair. 	 f. (-ला) Violent hic cough.  E. यम् to refrain, to cease, aff. कलच्; or यमं योगं लाति ला-क ।

(-ना) The YAMUNĀ or Jamunā river, which rises on the south side of the Himālaya range, at a short distance to the north-west of the source of the Ganges, and which after a course of about 378 miles falls into that river immediately below Allāhābād; in mythology, the personified river is considered as the daughter of SŪRYA, and sister of YAMA. ययाति: ययाति m. (-तिः) A monarch of India the fifth of the lunar race and son of NAHUSA. At first he married Devajāni, the only child of SŪKRA, the preceptor of the demons and subsequently ŚARMISHṬHĀ the daughter of VRISHAPARVAN, who was ordered by her father to attend on Devajāni as a servant, as a punishment for her throwing her in a well. For his marrying and making love to ŚARMISHṬHĀ Yajāti became old and infirm before his time through the curse of SUKRA, but having appeased his father-in-law obtained permission to transfer his decrepitude to any one who would consent to take it. Out of his five sons PURU complied with his father's wishes. The King being endowed with renovated youth, passed his time in the enjoyment of pleasures for a full thousand years, and after which he restored his youth to PURU and resuming his own de-crepitude departed to the wood of penance.  E. यस्य वायोरिव याति-सर्वत्र रथगतिरस्य ।

योजनगन्धा: योजनगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 	 1. Musk. 	 2. A name of SĪTĀ. 	 3. A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of the sage and poet VYĀSA.  E. योजन a Yojana, and गन्ध smell; whose odour is perceptible miles off; also with कन् added, fem. form, योजनगन्धिका ।
योजनपर्णी: योजनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Bengal madder.  E. योजन joining, पर्ण leaf.
योजनवल्ली: योजनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) “मञ्जिष्ठायाम्.”  E. योजन joining, वल्ली pedicle.
योजनीय: योजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be joined. 	 2. To be added.  E. युज् to join, अनीयर् aff.
योजयितृ: योजयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Joining, combining, who or what unites. E. युज् to join, causal v., शतृ aff.
योजित: योजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed, joined.  E. युज् to join, aff. क्त; more usually युक्त ।
योतु: योतु m. (-तुः) 	 1. Measure in general. 	 2. Cleaning, purifying. 	 3. A clean-ser, a purifier.  E. यु to mix, or not to mix, and तुन् Unādi aff.
योत्र: योत्र n. (-त्रं) The tie that fastens the yoke of a plough to the neck of the ox.  E. यु to join, ष्ट्रन् aff.
योत्स्यमान: योत्स्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) About to fight, ready to fight.  E. युध् to fight, desid. v., future tense, शतृ aff.
योद्धव्य: योद्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be fought, what must or ought to be fought. E. युध् to fight, ण्यत् aff.
योद्धृ: योद्धृ m. (-द्धा) A warrior, a combatant.  E. युध् to fight, aff. तृच् ।
योध: योध m. (-धः) A warrior, a soldier, a combatant.  E. युध् to fight, aff. अच् ।
योधमुख्य: योधमुख्य m. (-ख्यः) A leader, a chief warrior.  E. योध and मुख्य chief.
योधयत्: योधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Fighting, warring.  E. युध् to fight, शतृ aff.
योधवीर: योधवीर m. (-रः) A hero, a warrior.  E. योध, and वीर a hero.
योधसंराव: योधसंराव m. (-वः) Mutual defiance, challenging or braving each other. E. योध a warrior, संराव cry or shout.
योधहर: योधहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Carrying soldiers fit for war, (horses.)  E. योध, हर what takes.
योधिन्: योधिन् m. (-धी) A warrior.  E. युध् to fight, घिनुण् aff.
योधेय: योधेय m. (-यः) A warrior.  E. युध् war, and ढक् aff.
योनल: योनल m. (-लः) A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) “दे-धान”.  E. यव barley, नल culm or stalk, the व of the first word cha-nged to उ, and उ with the inherent vowel of य changed to ओ ।
योनि: योनि mfn. (-निः-निः or -नी) 	 1. The vulva. 	 2. A mine. 	 3. Cause, origin. 4. Water. 	 5. Place or site of birth or production in general. 	 6. A repository, a seat. 	 7. Home, abode, nest. 	 8. A form of existence, race, birth, as in “देवयोनि,” &c.  E. यु to join or mix, Unādi aff. नि ।
योनिज: योनिज Adj. Born of the womb, viviparous.
योनिदेवता: योनिदेवता f. (-ता) The 11th Nakshatra or lunar asterism; also Pūrva-phālguni.  E. योनि the vulva, and देवता presiding deity.
योनिनासा: योनिनासा f. (-सा) The upper part of the vulva or the union of the labiæ. E. योनि the womb, and नासा the nose.
योनिभ्रंश: योनिभ्रंश m. (-शः) Fall of the womb, Prolapsus uteri.
योनिरञ्जन: योनिरञ्जन n. (-नं) The menstrual excretion.  E. योनि pudendum, रञ्जन colouring.
योनिलिङ्ग: योनिलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The clitoris.  E. योनि the pudendum, लिङ्ग the penis.
योनिसंवृत्ति: योनिसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Contraction or closure of the vagina.  E. योनि and संवृत्ति contraction.
योनिसङ्कर: योनिसङ्कर m. (-रः) Fault or blemish of birth on the mother's side, as from inferiority of caste, &c.  E. योनि, and सङ्कर mixture.
योन्यर्शस्: योन्यर्शस् n. (-र्शः) An affection of the vulva, Menorrhagia, or prolapsus uteri.  E. योनि the vulva, and अर्शस् piles.
योपन: योपन n. (-नं) 	 1. Effacing. 	 2. Anything used for effacing. 	 3. Destroying, oppressing.
योषा: योषा f. (-षा) A young women.  E. युष् to serve, sautra root, casual form, affs. अच् and टाप् ।
योषित्: योषित् f. (-षित्) A woman in general.  E. युष् Sautra root, to serve, to worship, to hurt, इति Unādi aff.; also with टाप् added योषिता f. (-ता) ।
योषित्कृत: योषित्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by a woman, contracted by her, &c.  E. योषिन् कृत done.
यौक्तिक: यौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Connective, binding. 	 2. Inferrible, deducible. 3. Customary, usual. 	 4. Right, proper. 	 5. Founded on reasoning, logical. 	 m. (-कः) A minister or associate to one's pleasure or amusement.  E. युक्ति union, association, aff. ठक् ।
यौगक: यौगक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the religious practice, &c. called Yoga.  E. योग, ठञ् aff.
यौगिक: यौगिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Customary, usual, common. 	 2. Relating to the Yoga, &c. 	 3. Proper, regular, (as the sense of words, depen-ing upon their derivation or construction.)  E. योग and ठञ् aff.
यौजनशतिक: यौजनशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Proceeding or extending a hundred Yoja-nas.  E. योजन a measure so named, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
यौजनिक: यौजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Extending, &c. a Yojana.  E. योजन्, ठञ् aff.
यौट्: यौट् (ऋ) यौटृ r. 1st cl. (यौटति) To bind, to tie, to fasten; also यौडृ ।
यौतक: यौतक n. (-कं) A nuptial gift, presents made to a bride, at her marri-age, by her father or friends; some consider it also implying a gift to the bridegroom.  E. युतक the same, pleonastic aff. अण् ।
यौतव: यौतव n. (-वं) Measure in general.  E. योतु the same, अण् aff.; some authorities read यौवत and पौतव ।
यौधेय: यौधेय m. (-यः) A warrior.  E. योधेय the same, and अण् pleonasm.
यौन: यौन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Relating to the womb or place of origin, uterine: 2. Connected by female alliance, marriage, &c.  E. योनि and अण् aff.
यौवत: यौवत n. (-तं) 	 1. Measure in general. 	 2. An assemblage of young wo-men. 	 3. The state of being a youthful woman.  E. यु to mix, deriv. irr.; or युवती a young woman, aff. अण् ।
यौवन: यौवन n. (-नं) 	 1. Youth, manhood, prime of life, puberty. 	 2. An assem-blage of young women.  E. युवन् young, अण् aff.; with कन् यौवनक ।
यौवनकण्टक: यौवनकण्टक m. (-कः) Pimples on the face, especially in young persons. E. यौवन youth, and कण्टक a thorn.
यौवनदर्प: यौवनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of youth, rashness, conceit.  E. यौवन, दर्प pride.
यौवनदशा: यौवनदशा f. (-शा) The period of youth.  E. यौवन, दशा state.
यौवनपिडका: यौवनपिडका f. (-का) Blotches on the face in youth.  E. यौवन, पिडका pimples, &c.
यौवनलक्षण: यौवनलक्षण n. (-ण) 	 1. The bosom, the female breast. 	 2. Beauty, hand-someness, charm, loveliness. 	 3. Characteristic of youth.  E. यौवन youth, लक्षण mark or sign.
यौवनवत्: यौवनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Youthful.  E. यौवन, and मतुप् aff.
यौवनाश्व: यौवनाश्व m. (-श्वः) A name of MĀNDHĀTṚ, one of the kings of the solar dynasty.  E. युवनाश्व a proper name, and अण् patronymic aff.
यौवराज्य: यौवराज्य n. (-ज्यं) The office of YUVARĀJA.
यौष्माक: यौष्माक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Yours, belonging to you.  E. युष्माक for युष्मद you, aff. अण् ।
यौष्माकीन: यौष्माकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Yours, thine.  E. युष्माक for युष्मद् thou, स्वञ् aff.
